title: Sony BRAVIA KD-55XF8096 (2018, model string "BRAVIA 4K GB ATV3", product BRAVIA_ATV3_4K_EU, MediaTek MT5891), Spain
header:
Sony BRAVIA KD-55XF8096 (2018, model string "BRAVIA 4K GB ATV3", product BRAVIA_ATV3_4K_EU, MediaTek MT5891), Spain
Android TV 9 (API 28), firmware Sony/BRAVIA_ATV3_4K_EU/BRAVIA_ATV3_4K:9/PTT1.190515.001.S54/672201:user/release-keys,
security patch 2022-01-05 (Sony has stopped updating it). 2 GB RAM.

Apply:   TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/disable.sh examples/sony-kd-55xf8096/debloat.txt
Undo:    TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/restore.sh examples/sony-kd-55xf8096/debloat.txt
Everything is DISABLED, not uninstalled. Comment out any line you want to keep.

Same hardware (MT5891) and Android build (S54) as examples/sony-bravia-4k-gb and examples/sony-kd-55xe8596 (S52).
BRAVIA_ATV3_4K_EU is the 2018 XF-series refresh of the 2017 BRAVIA_ATV2_EU (XE-series).
Package set is nearly identical; differences noted below.

Applied and reboot-checked on 2026-10-22. Home, live TV, HDMI inputs, DLNA, IR remote and HbbTV
(red button) all work after reboot. Re-enable anything that breaks with `pm enable <package>`.

Stock launcher: com.google.android.tvlauncher. Its HOME filter has priority 2,
so `cmd package set-home-activity` reports Success but does nothing until it is disabled.
Live TV / input app: com.sony.dtv.tvx. Keep it: it drives every HDMI input too.
Keep: com.sony.dtv.tvinput.*, braviasync* (HDMI-CEC), remotepairing, rcpowerkey, uinputservice,
imeproxy, sonysystemservice, settingsprovider, all com.mediatek.* and mtktvapi.agent, timers,
webapi.core, remoteaccess (Sony IP Control / Home Assistant Bravia integration),
com.sony.huey.dlna.module (DLNA renderer), com.uei.quicksetsdk.sony (IR universal remote),
com.vewd.core.integration.dia (HbbTV / red button).

New in ATV3 vs ATV2/XE8596: com.sony.dtv.smarthomesettings (Alexa setup, runs at every boot),
com.sony.dtv.discovery + com.sony.dtv.bivlinfo (Sony Discover content bar and its feeds),
com.sony.dtv.scrums.action was present but uninstalled to remove home screen ads — not in this list
(disable.sh uses pm disable-user only; uninstall --user 0 is irreversible).
